cases.name: CHK-001:edge:1 no orphan handler modules in mcp/handlers

cases.execute: const {readFileSync}=await import('fs');const {readdirSync}=await import('fs');function walk(d){let r=[];try{for(const e of readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(e.isDirectory())r=r.concat(walk(d+'/'+e.name));else if(e.name.endsWith('.ts'))r.push(d+'/'+e.name)}}catch{}return r}const files=walk($root+'/packages/main/src');for(const f of files){if(readFileSync(f,'utf-8').includes('@modelcontextprotocol'))return 'found in '+f}return 'no MCP import'

cases.name: CHK-002:adversarial:1 no MCP export + no serve script + no SDK import in any src
cases.execute: const {readFileSync,readdirSync}=await import('fs');const pkg=JSON.parse(readFileSync($root+'/packages/main/package.json','utf-8'));const issues=[];if(pkg.exports?.['./mcp'])issues.push('mcp export');if(pkg.scripts?.serve)issues.push('serve script');function walk(d){let r=[];try{for(const e of readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(e.isDirectory())r=r.concat(walk(d+'/'+e.name));else if(e.name.endsWith('.ts'))r.push(d+'/'+e.name)}}catch{}return r}for(const f of walk($root+'/packages/main/src')){if(readFileSync(f,'utf-8').includes('@modelcontextprotocol'))issues.push('import in '+f.split('/').pop())}return issues.length?'issues: '+issues.join(', '):'fully removed'

cases.name: CHK-004:adversarial:0 no MCP/flow residue in docs and agent prompts
cases.execute: const {existsSync,readdirSync,readFileSync}=await import('fs');const keywords=['mcp server','flow_trace','@flow'];function checkFile(p){if(!existsSync(p))return null;const c=readFileSync(p,'utf-8').toLowerCase();for(const k of keywords){if(c.includes(k))return k+' in '+p.split('/').pop()}return null}const issues=[];const r1=checkFile($root+'/CLAUDE.md');if(r1)issues.push(r1);if(existsSync($root+'/README.md')){const r2=checkFile($root+'/README.md');if(r2)issues.push(r2)}const agentsDir=$root+'/.claude/agents';if(existsSync(agentsDir)){for(const f of readdirSync(agentsDir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.md'))){const r=checkFile(agentsDir+'/'+f);if(r)issues.push(r)}}return issues.length?'found: '+issues.join(', '):'clean'

cases.name: CHK-004:adversarial:1 no @flow/flow_trace/MCP server in CLAUDE.md
cases.execute: const {readFileSync}=await import('fs');const c=readFileSync($root+'/CLAUDE.md','utf-8');const issues=[];if(c.includes('@flow'))issues.push('@flow');if(c.includes('flow_trace'))issues.push('flow_trace');if(c.toLowerCase().includes('mcp server'))issues.push('MCP server');return issues.length?'found: '+issues.join(', '):'clean'
